metadata.description: Self-service analytics agents: a consumption plugin for business users and an authoring/QA plugin for the data team.

plugins.name: analytics-desk
plugins.description: Ask the warehouse questions in plain language. Routes every question through the governed metric layer first, reviews its own SQL adversarially, and answers with a provenance footer.

plugins.name: analytics-workbench
plugins.description: For the data team: QA an analysis, author and maintain the reference docs the agent retrieves, run and ablate the offline eval suite, and migrate Databricks Genie spaces into it.
